entries.explanation: Reconstructs the grounding proposal as a cumulative unity of rational, moral and aesthetic norms, rather than claiming that physical causation alone defeats reasoning.
Replaces the bottle-fizz comparison with an explicit distinction between causal reliability and normative justification, while conceding that evolved cognition can successfully track truth.
Adds an abductive convergence argument from three forms of disciplined answerability, giving the shared normative structure an explanatory role not established in the live triad assertion.
Develops beauty as purposive communication across sustained intelligibility while conceding secular awe and accidental resemblance, instead of using an isolated pattern as proof of design.
Combines corrigible inquiry, interpersonal reasons and cultivated aesthetic standards into a constructive secular account beyond the speakers' narrower individual counterexamples.

Adds independent replication, failed predictions and collective correction as concrete reliability mechanisms, answering the chemistry challenge without claiming that natural selection guarantees infallible reasoning.
Develops the victim standpoint into reciprocal public justification and applies that standard to alleged divine commands, supplying normative reasoning beyond the live personal objection.

Explains how historically accumulated criticism and perceptual constraints can support revisable aesthetic standards, extending preservation examples without asserting that every preference is equally warranted.
